notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nested Ghoul indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Nested Ghoul.
description:
Give Nested Ghoul indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Nested Ghoul.
Nested Ghoul triggers, creating a 2/2 Phyrexian Zombie creature token.
The Phyrexian Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing damage equal to the Phyrexian Zombie's power to Nested Ghoul.
Repeat from step 3.
